mapper.select: select * from product order by product_id

SELECT * FROM product WHERE max_rate IS NOT NULL AND ( -- 예금 : 최소 가입금액이 내 자산 이하 (product_type = '예금' AND (min_amount IS NULL OR min_amount <= #{amount})) OR -- 적금 : (월 최대납입 × 최대개월수)가 내 자산 이하 (product_type = '적금' AND (max_amount * max_period) <= #{amount}) ) ORDER BY max_rate DESC LIMIT 1
